definitions.friday_close: Close of last 15m bar < Fri 21:00 UTC (<=6h guard)
definitions.monday_open: Open of first 15m bar >= Sun 21:00 UTC (<=24h guard)
definitions.signal: fade gap toward Friday close; event bar excluded from forward windows
definitions.aud_note: AUD_JPY has no 12y parquet (starts 2021-12); AUD_USD substituted, RT 2.5p assumed (not in KB)
